# QHEHaldaneBasis

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/QHEHaldaneBasis`

```text
QHEHaldaneBasis, version 0.01

Usage: QHEHaldaneBasis [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (0 if it has to be taken from reference state file definition) (default value = 0)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (0 if it has to be taken from reference state file definition) (default value = 0)
    -z, --lz-value : twice the lz value corresponding to the eigenvector (default value = 0)
    --huge : use huge Hilbert space support
    --symmetrized-basis : use Lz <-> -Lz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-lz=0)
    --show-basis : show basis states
    --file-size : maximum file size (in MBytes) when using huge mode (default value = 0)
    --memory : maximum memory (in MBytes) that can allocated for precalculations when using huge mode (default value = 100)
    --reference-state : reference state to start the Haldane algorithm from (can be laughlin, pfaffian or readrezayi3)
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:
    --save-hilbert : save Hilbert space description in the indicated file and exit (only available for the Haldane basis)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
